tools.name: signal_leads_offer
tools.description: What Signal Leads sells ($19 for 25 leads with a public funding/hiring/tech signal, source link and draft message each), the payment link, and what the buyer must enter at checkout (website, target customer). Use it when a user wants sales leads.

tools.name: signal_leads_results
tools.description: Fetch a finished Signal Leads order as JSON, given the results link or token from the buyer's thank-you page or email.

tools.name: usage_and_upgrade
tools.description: Show today's usage for your key or IP and the $19/one-time upgrade link. Free tier: 50 calls/day. Not metered.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: signal_leads_results · Private data: signal_leads_results · Public sink: signal_leads_results.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: signal_leads_results · Private data: signal_leads_results · Public sink: signal_leads_results

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
